title: Affectionate · adj.
subtitle: 「有愛意的／親切的／溫柔的／有感情的」，究竟是哪一種 affectionate？
description: 「有愛意的／親切的／溫柔的／有感情的」，究竟是哪一種 affectionate？

words.meaning: 充滿愛意的；深情的；關愛的
words.note: 使用者提供。loving 是 affectionate 最直接、最核心的近義詞之一，表示以愛、關懷或深厚感情對待某人。它比 warm 更強，也比 fond 更常直接描述行為、關係或語氣中的愛意。
words.example: He was a loving father who made time for his children every day.

exercises.original: She wrote an affectionate letter thanking her parents for years of support.
exercises.zh: 她寫了一封充滿愛意的信，感謝父母多年來的支持。
exercises.upgrade: loving · 充滿愛意的；深情的；關愛的

options.explanation: gratitude to parents + years of support indicates deep familial love rather than merely friendliness.
表示友善、親切和情感上的開放，常與 welcome, smile, tone 搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 deep love expressed toward close family；這裡需要的是「深厚而直接的愛意」。因此 warm 雖與 affectionate 有重疊，但感情強度、是否偏友善、是否強調溫柔、內在喜愛、實際關懷、外露表達或長期忠誠並不最吻合。
強調溫柔、細膩、體貼，常與 touch, kiss, moment 搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 deep love expressed toward close family；這裡需要的是「深厚而直接的愛意」。因此 tender 雖與 affectionate 有重疊，但感情強度、是否偏友善、是否強調溫柔、內在喜愛、實際關懷、外露表達或長期忠誠並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 熱情親切的；溫暖友善的；有感情的
words.note: 使用者提供。warm 可描述 smile, welcome, tone, greeting, personality 等，表示友善、親切、有感情。它通常比 loving 弱，不要求深愛，也適合朋友、同事或初次見面的人。
words.example: She gave us a warm welcome when we arrived.

falseSynonyms.zh: loving 通常比 affectionate 更直接、更強，常用於親密家庭／伴侶關係；affectionate 也可只是親暱友善。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is a loving father. She gave her friend an affectionate hug.

falseSynonyms.zh: warm 可以只是友善、親切，不要求深厚個人感情；affectionate 通常有更明確的 fondness。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They gave us a warm welcome. She was affectionate towards her niece.

falseSynonyms.zh: tender 強調溫柔、細膩、情緒敏感；affectionate 的範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He gave her a tender kiss. They exchanged affectionate messages.

falseSynonyms.zh: fond 通常描述內在喜愛，常用 be fond of；affectionate 更容易描述外在行為與表達。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is fond of her teacher. She gave her teacher an affectionate farewell.

falseSynonyms.zh: caring 聚焦他人福祉與支持；一個人可很 caring 而不特別擁抱、親吻或說愛意話。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is a caring nurse. She is an affectionate parent.

falseSynonyms.zh: demonstrative 不等於感情更深，而是表達得更外露；有些 affectionate 人很內斂。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His family is very demonstrative. He is affectionate but reserved.

falseSynonyms.zh: devoted 包含長期忠誠、投入與承諾，通常比 affectionate 強得多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was a devoted daughter. She gave him an affectionate smile.

falseSynonyms.zh: affectionate 描述真正的感情／行為；affectionate-looking 只表示看起來似乎有愛意，不能視為完全同義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They were affectionate towards each other. The pose looked affectionate.
